purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official Tarbaj Form 34B final TOTAL row, read directly from the official IEBC portal PDF.

sample.review_context_note: Full official-page raster rendered directly from the freshly downloaded, sha256-verified official IEBC Form 34B PDF, then cropped at 300 DPI around the TOTAL row for digit-level confirmation. This TOTAL row is plain grey-shaded (not the more common green shading), so the automated green-band row locator did not isolate it; the row was located and cropped manually. The portal only served this PDF after a home-page + set-election (2022 General Election, election id 5) session handshake.

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session, its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and the TOTAL row integers were read directly from the rendered page image. No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values. Constituency identity (TARBAJ, code 035, county WAJIR code 008) was read from the page header ('Name of Constituency: TARBAJ Code: 035', 'Name of County: WAJIR Code: 008') and cross-checked against the visible 'CON 035' banner marker printed on the page before this row was accepted.

same_row_valid_vote_reconciliation.method: Independent visual read of the four presidential candidate total cells on the same final TOTAL row.

note: This evidence establishes a source-verified row under the extraction contract. The printed Registered Voters figure (25,267) matches the governed P23 ward-summed registered-voters denominator (KDA-VOTERS-CON-035-2022) exactly, and the four candidate cells sum exactly to the printed Total Valid Votes. Canonical materialization is authorized only by the separate governed promotion tranche in data/p23/form34b-turnout-promotion-contract.json.
